articles.title: Memory, not processors, remains Europe's supercomputing weakness, Bull CEO says
articles.description: Bull, a French supercomputer maker, reports an increase in local sourcing of its components to 70%. Despite the progress in sourcing, memory components still lack European suppliers. The CEO expressed concerns over rising memory prices and the reliance on non-European manufacturers. Notable initiatives for memory production in Europe exist but are expected to take considerable time. Current industry dynamics show dominance by Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron in memory production.

Amazon to invest $1 billion over five years in US data center communities
articles.description: In a bold move, Amazon has pledged to pour more than $1 billion into the communities hosting its data centers, aiming to alleviate worries about resource consumption. Facing pushback due to environmental ramifications, the company, via Amazon Web Services, has also vowed to achieve water positivity by 2030. These steps are part of a broader strategy accompanying the expansion of its data center network across various states.
